items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: they might have read about Richard Burton’s first wife Sybil... my parents up in Thunder Bay. They probably read more about Sybil

ctx.x: Well I think they were more interested in the side of it, they might have read about Richard Burton’s first wife Sybil, who had a famous disco in New York called Arthur in the society crowd. And they subscribed to the New Yorker, my parents up in Thunder Bay. They probably read more about Sybil and maybe the Peppermint Lounge, how they, you know, the society matrons were going there and twisting the night away and stuff. And they — you know — that was more, and the go-go girls and stuff they would have read about…

Did you start to notice arrangements, the particular sound of a record and what gave it some distinction from the person behind that we rarely hear about, the cat that arranged the horns and chose the — you know we’re going to put a harpsichord in here and all that. Did that seep into your consciousness?
